newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson signs 400 mln skr Czech deal.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson signs 400 mln skr Czech deal.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group AB LM Ericsson said on Tuesday it signed a deal worth 400 million crowns with Rann International of Florida for a mobile telephone system in the Czech Republic.

"The network will be a fixed wireless system which will initially be used to provide telephone service in the countryside of Czech republic and subsequently be expanded to urban areas," Ericsson said in a statement.

The system uses mobile telephone technology to provide a basic telephone service. Such a system can be expanded to a mixed network, using mobile and fixed telephones, provided the proper licensing is obtained.
Service is scheduled to begin in November 1997, it said.
Ericsson said the contract was the company's first order for such a system, a D-AMPS IS-136, in central Europe.
